title: Improving Affine-Equivalence Algorithm Complexity and Applicability
summary: An improved affine-equivalence algorithm targets randomly chosen permutations, but reducing its computational complexity and broadening its applicability remain open.

formal_statement.body: For the affine-equivalence problem, an improved algorithm is known that focuses on randomly chosen permutations; the open task is to further improve its computational complexity and broaden its applicability.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis using affine-equivalence algorithms for randomly chosen permutations.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Further improve the algorithm’s computational complexity and broaden its applicability.

citations.label: An Improved Affine Equivalence Algorithm for Random Permutations

progress.summary: The paper reports an improved affine-equivalence algorithm focused on randomly chosen permutations, then explicitly identifies further improvements in complexity and applicability as the main open problem.
citation_labels: Itai Dinur et al., An Improved Affine Equivalence Algorithm for Random Permutations
